title: peltophorum linnaei
intro: Peltophorum linnaei, commonly known as the Yellow Flame Tree, is a plant species native to Australia and New Guinea. It is a flowering tree that has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its various health benefits. The plant is known for its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which have been reported to provide therapeutic actions such as reducing pain and inflammation, and also exhibiting antimicrobial and antifungal activities. The bioactive constituents present in Peltophorum linnaei include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and health benefits.
